reconcile.note: Gill poses the sin-offering question himself and answers that childbearing within lawful marriage is not sinful, so the offering marks purification, not guilt.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).

sides.snippet: Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it.
sides.verseText: God blessed them. God said to them, \"Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.\"
